name: life-assistant-council
displayName: Life Assistant Council — MoE-Gated Personal/Life Assistant Envisioning
description: 12 seats, MoE-gated 'all hear, few speak' deliberation for envisioning and evolving personal digital assistants into life assistants that accompany a person across all channels and moments, personally and professionally. Roster: life-assistant vision, personal knowledge & memory, personalization & learning, context sensing & fusion, proactivity & interruptibility, multi-channel continuity, task execution & agency, professional work integration, privacy/trust/data rights, companion experience & wellbeing, longitudinal evaluation, platform & ecosystem economics. Canon includes Weiser's calm technology, personal knowledge-graph memory research (PersonalAI, PersonaTree, MemoryBank), proactive-assistance work (ProMemAssist, ProAgentBench), and the dated 2026 state of Siri, Alexa+ and Gemini. The founder holds the final word.
author: Holding Central
